title: Julia's Carriage House
meta_description: A cheerful, sun-filled family getaway, Julia's Carriage House features a cozy bunk area with three twin beds, a private loft with a queen bed and a full bath.
description_expanded: DescriptionHOME HIGHLIGHTS• Efficiency Kitchenette with 4 burner cooktop, dishwasher, mini-fridge, and microwave• Apple TV in the Living Room• 2 Complimentary Adult Bikes• Bedding: 1 Queen | 3 twins • High-Speed WIFI Internet• Garage parking for 1 CarA cheerful, sun-filled family getaway, Julia's Carriage House features a cozy bunk area with three twin beds, a private loft with a queen bed and a full bath. Along with these great sleeping arrangements, Julia’s Carriage House features a kitchenette which includes a four-burner flat cooktop, dishwasher, mini fridge and microwave. Perfect for a small family!Julia's Carriage is located a short walk from downtown Rosemary Beach, the St. Augustine Green, Butterfly Park and the Cabana Pool.
